description: This file declares protocols, functions, and constants for the communication protocol used in the confui (confirmation UI) component within the cuttlefish project, including message handling and transmission functions.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a ConfUiMessage object into its string representation.

methods.name: RecvConfUiMsg
methods.description: Receives a confirmation UI message from the given shared file descriptor or session ID.

methods.name: SendAbortCmd
methods.description: Sends an abort command over the specified file descriptor for the given session.

methods.name: SendAck
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment message with success or failure status.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message including a plain selection and signed response data.

methods.name: SendStartCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to start the UI prompt with optional data and locale.

methods.name: SendStopCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to stop the UI session.

methods.name: SendUserSelection
methods.description: Sends user selection or cancellation over the shared file descriptor.
